# OpenVinci

> Image generation for agents. `vinci` calls an image API in one shell call, giving agents text-to-image and local image editing. No SDK, no MCP, no daemon.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/SKILL.md): Agent install and calling contract — start here
- [First use](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/docs/first-use.md): Agent-guided model, API Base URL, and API key setup with reusable local configuration (Chinese)
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/README.md): Human-facing install and usage
- [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/install.sh): One-line installer used by the skill

- [Image editing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/docs/image-editing.md): Local images, masks, and APIMart Base64 support
- [Image models and quality](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/docs/image-models.md): GPT Image 2.5 model selection, FlatRouter setup, and live verification limits (Chinese)

## Optional

- [ADR-0003 async envelopes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/docs/adr/0003-async-gateway-polling.md): Why vinci polls task ids internally
- [Release process](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BubblePtr/openvinci/main/docs/release.md): How humans cut a GitHub Release
